entities.name: Haliya
entities.description: Human aspirant of the Sunstar Free Company and squire of Syr Vondam.

entities.name: Syr Vondam
entities.description: Solar Knight of the Sunstar Free Company, mentor of Haliya.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: Order of knights Haliya joined as an aspirant.

entities.name: Solar Knights
entities.description: Knights who reignited the star over Haliya's homeworld.

entities.name: Alpharael
entities.description: A Monoist who threw away his sekhar singularity bead and escaped.

entities.name: Captain Slats
entities.description: Astelli captain who prophesied Vondam's death.

entities.name: Monoists
entities.description: Attackers of the Dawnsire; their strike cadre assaulted the dreadnought.

entities.name: Dawnsire
entities.description: Sunstar dreadnought that traveled to the Sothera system.

entities.name: Candela
entities.description: Shieldship of the Dawnsire where Haliya was stationed.

entities.name: Endstone
entities.description: A dangerous object that manipulated events and revised the timeline.

entities.name: Seriema
entities.description: Ship Haliya boarded to destroy Alpharael.

entities.name: Sami
entities.description: Person Haliya killed aboard the Seriema before the Endstone revised the timeline.

entities.name: Tannuk
entities.description: Person Haliya killed aboard the Seriema before the Endstone revised the timeline.

entities.name: Infinite Guideline Station
entities.description: Station where Vondam cast Haliya out of the Free Company.

entities.name: Wurmwall
entities.description: Place where Haliya met a Vaar.

entities.name: Vaar
entities.description: A being that came for the Endstone and crushed Haliya's throat.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: System the Dawnsire traveled to, to revive the supervoid.

events.summary: Solar Knights reignite the star of Haliya's frozen homeworld; she joins the Sunstar Free Company and becomes Vondam's squire.
events.quote: The Solar Knights arrived and reignited the star

events.summary: Monoists attack the Dawnsire; Vondam and Haliya help lead the defense, and Slats prophesies Vondam's death.
events.quote: it was attacked by a strike cadre of Monoists

events.summary: Alpharael throws away his singularity bead, which passes through Vondam's head without lethal damage.
events.quote: Along the way, it went directly through Syr Vondam's head, apparently killing him.

events.summary: Vondam deduces the Endstone manipulated events and resolves to pursue Alpharael.
events.quote: he suspected that Alpharael would come in possession of a very dangerous object, the Endstone

events.summary: Haliya boards the Seriema and kills Sami and Tannuk before Alpharael sedates her; the Endstone revises the timeline so they were only knocked out.
events.quote: she killed Sami and Tannuk before Alpharael sedated her

events.summary: At Infinite Guideline Station Vondam casts Haliya out of the Free Company; she subdues him.
events.quote: she was stopped by Syr Vondam, who cast her out of the Free Company

events.summary: At the Wurmwall Haliya meets a Vaar and severs two of its fingers as it crushes her throat.
events.quote: severed two of its fingers as it crushed her throat

relations.quote: She is the squire of Syr Vondam
Syr Vondam, her mentor and idol, trained her since she was young.
Haliya is a human aspirant of the Sunstar Free Company in the Edge .
